items.title: Sherrie Maricle interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 4, 2020 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: you just keep finding new things and new videos and new lessons. And it’s great. ... all these things of Max Roach or Elvin Jones or Philly Joe Jones

ctx.x: Well that’s one upside. I’m curious what does a drumset player practice for five hours?

Oh my gosh, well I spend a lot of time working on different, and this is recently, just different technical things and technical approaches. Like there’s a lot more than one way to hit a drum, this way, there’s using your fingers, there’s using every finger, there’s stick placement, there’s wrist movement, there’s certain bounce techniques and with both hands and both feet I just, stuff like that, I’m like wow. Like for example on thing I practice quite a bit it’s called a push/pull technique and a lot of…
Well not only that I think you just gave a brief lesson to like wind players — that was some pretty cool double tonguing you just did [scats].
